findings.action: Upgrade to a fixed RouterOS release; remove SSH/management from untrusted networks; inspect Flagged state, users, scripts and configuration after upgrade.

findings.action: Require vm2 >= 3.12.2 for this snapshot, reject dangerous NodeVM configurations, and do not use same-process vm2 as the sole boundary for hostile code.
findings.verify: Dependency gate passes and untrusted execution is additionally isolated at process/container/VM boundary.

findings.action: Upgrade VMware Workstation/Fusion 25H2 or 26H1 to 26H1u1. There is no vendor workaround.
findings.verify: Installed product version is 26H1u1 or later.

findings.reason: vendor-specific patch state must be verified
findings.action: Install all currently applicable Microsoft security updates for the deployed Windows release; reboot if required; then re-scan. This group includes the September exploited privilege-escalation issues plus earlier 2026 actively exploited Netlogon/IKE issues. Do not treat successful installation as proof that prior exploitation did not occur.
findings.verify: No applicable security updates remain and installed OS build is at or above Microsoft fixed build for the deployed release.
